what: Structural `# Pin:` comment must be updated with the CLI cutover
scenario_or_breakage: `scripts/test-review-structure.sh` pin (13) greps one line containing `collect-agent-results.sh`, `--timeout 1860`, `--substantive-validation`, and `--validation-mode`. Today that is the `# Pin:` comment, not the runtime invocation (`args=(--timeout "$TIMEOUT" …)` is on another line). Renaming the collector without updating this comment breaks `make test-review-structure` even if the subshell invocation is correct.
suggested_fix: Add an explicit plan step to rewrite the `# Pin:` comment to `agent collect-results --timeout 1860 --substantive-validation --validation-mode` when switching `collect-findings.sh` to the Python CLI.
